title: RUREX consortium: Horizon Europe bid on rural energy resilience

decision.body: RUREX steering group (Rīgas Tehniskā universitāte, Fraunhofer IEE, Kaunas University of Technology, AS "Sadales tīkls", Ogres novada pašvaldība)
decision.result: The steering group resolved to submit a full proposal to HORIZON-CL5-2026-D3-02-11 with RTU as coordinator, and instructed the coordination office to assemble the consortium and the mandatory annexes against the call deadline of 12 November 2026.
decision.quorum: 9 of 11 steering group members present, 9 in favour, 2 absent and bound by the written procedure

initiative.title: RUREX — proposal assembly for HORIZON-CL5-2026-D3-02-11
initiative.objective: Submit a complete and admissible proposal to HORIZON-CL5-2026-D3-02-11 (rural energy resilience and community flexibility) before the call closes on 12 November 2026 at 17:00 Brussels time. Success is a consortium of eleven beneficiaries from at least six Member States, of which at least two are legally established in a widening country, with every mandatory annex signed and uploaded no later than forty-eight hours before the deadline. The steering group has recorded that a proposal submitted without evidenced matched co-funding is to be treated as a failed submission and not as a partial one.
constraints: The call closes on 12 November 2026 at 17:00 Brussels time; the submission portal does not accept late uploads and there is no extension procedure.
At least two beneficiaries must be legally established in a widening country, evidenced by a validated PIC.
No personal data may be collected for the household survey before a data protection impact assessment has been signed by a certified data protection officer.
Matched co-funding must be evidenced by a council decision or a board minute; a letter of intent is not accepted as evidence.
Partner financial capacity annexes must be produced in the portal template; scanned PDFs are rejected at validation.
English is the language of record for the proposal; national-language versions exist only for municipal files.

thresholds_measured.rule: lowest threshold whose measured wrong-bind rate is zero and which sits at least 0.03 clear of the highest threshold that still produced one; where none ever did, the configured value stands
thresholds_measured.note: wrong binds up to 0.77, none from 0.78; 0.81 is the first zero row clear of it. The old 0.97 was swept on the rules engine and discarded almost every bind
